cases.name: metal-control
cases.interpretation: Metal-only ext2sim returns; subsequent resistance attempt crashes. This attempt also reports invalid zero tolerance and cell lookup diagnostics.
cases.script:
load metal_control
box values 0 0 2000 80
paint metal2
box values 0 0 80 80
label A center metal2
port make 1
box values 1920 0 2000 80
label B center metal2
port make 2
save
extract all
puts "STAGE before_ext2sim"
ext2sim
puts "STAGE after_ext2sim"
extresist threshold 0
extresist tolerance 0
extresist simplify off
extresist all
extresist
puts "STAGE after_extresist"
quit -noprompt
